name: shield guardian
desc: Shield Guardian is a CR 7 construct.
languages: understands commands given in any language but can't speak

actions.name: bound
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is magically bound to an amulet. As long as the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} to travel to it, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}.

actions.name: regeneration
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} regains [[/healing]] at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: spell storing
actions.desc: A spellcaster who wears the shield [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s amulet can cause the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} to store one spell of 4th level or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. The spell has no effect but is stored within the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. When commanded to do so by the wearer or when a situation arises that was predefined by the spellcaster, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts the stored spell with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no components. When the spell is cast or a new spell is stored, any previously stored spell is lost. Foundry Note Add a spell into the Cast activity on this feature to allow the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} to caster the spell. Remove the spell from the activity afterwards.

actions.name: shield
actions.desc: When a creature makes an attack against the wearer of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s amulet, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} grants a +2 bonus to the wearer's AC if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is within 5 feet of the wearer.
